hero.title: Choose the plan that
hero.subtitle: Every individual account starts free, so you can build a strategy, run it through the optimizer, and see what Fintela can do from there. Upgrade whenever you need more room to work. Business and partner accounts are handled directly with our team, not through a listed plan.

individual.title: Individual
individual.description: Every plan includes the core platform: strategy building, backtesting, and Fintelligent. Higher tiers raise how much of it you get.

basic.name: Basic
basic.description: For traders trying Fintela for the first time. No card required.

pro.name: Pro
pro.description: For traders who are actively developing and iterating on strategies week to week.

proPlus.name: Pro+
proPlus.description: For traders running large searches and keeping a deep library of strategies on hand.

business.title: Business
business.description: Fintela is early stage, and we work with businesses and partners directly rather than through a self serve plan. Running a fund, integrating with Fintela, or exploring a partnership? Get in touch with our team directly and we'll figure out the right fit together.
